sources.title: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B: On-Device LLM for Android
sources.snippet: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B is a 1.5 billion parameter language model optimized for on-device deployment on Android, iOS, and web platforms via Google's LiteRT stack. It is a distilled version of DeepSeek-R1 adapted for edge inference with quantization support. The model is MIT-licensed, ungated, and includes pre-built TFLite variants.
